title: Initiative landing zones and commitment ownership protocol
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: cross-functional initiatives frequently lack a single, discoverable artifact that ties company-level OKRs to owner-level commitments, delivery milestones, rollout gates, and rollback plans. That creates misalignment at planning and leads to last-minute scope changes and unclear escalation paths.

Proposal: introduce an "Initiative Landing Zone" (ILZ) artifact and a Commitment Ownership Protocol (COP). Each ILZ is a minimal, standardized artifact stored in Confluence/Drive that includes at-a-glance OKR mapping, outcome metrics, primary/secondary owners, RACI, milestone cadence, gating criteria for canary/cutover, risk & rollback, and a dependency register. COP defines expected lifecycle interactions (review cadence, gating approvals, and escalation triggers) between PM, Eng, Design, Security, and Sales.

Deliverables:
- ILZ Confluence template + Drive folder skeleton + initiative checklist
- COP runbook (who reviews at each gate, SLA for review)
- Initiative dashboard config in roadmap tracking board (columns to show gate status)
- Canonical dependency register format and upstream/downstream mapping rules
- Training session + office hours for PMs and Eng leads

Why different from existing work: the ILZ centers ownership and gating as a first-class artifact (not just a roadmap line item). This ties the company-level OKR down to the explicit owner commitments and reduces ambiguity at handoff moments (design freeze, canary, GA).
success_metrics: All company-level initiatives have ILZ created within 2 weeks of kickoff
Number of scope changes after gating decreases by 40% QoQ
>90% of ILZs pass design/eng/security gates without >1 rework cycle
Time-to-decision for gating approvals reduced to <=48 hours
acceptance_criteria: Confluence ILZ template is published and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design
COP runbook published and signed off by Legal/Security/CTO
Roadmap board includes new gate-status column and is populated for >3 pilot initiatives
One pilot initiative completes ILZ lifecycle (kickoff -> canary -> GA) and shows tracked metrics

Gate reviews may become a bottleneck if approver SLAs are not enforced
Incomplete dependency data could cause missed downstream impacts
Private deployment security gating introduces extra latency to approvals
